-- SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later
-- The cores held on each of nodes $1 by placements of workloads other than $2: what the scheduler
-- gives none of again. Both of a migration's placements hold theirs.
SELECT node_id, cores FROM placement
 WHERE node_id = ANY($1) AND workload_id <> $2 AND cardinality(cores) > 0
